tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an Assessment Order issued under Section 143(3) read with Section 144B of the Income-tax Act, 1961, in relation to the income tax return filed for Assessment Year 2024–25. The Assessing Officer has proposed certain additions to the returned income, resulting in a total tax demand of Rs. 1.28 crore, including interest.
tax_litigation.status: Based on the advice of tax advisors, the Company believes that the aforementioned demand is not maintainable and has filed an appeal against the said Order. Accordingly, there is no immediate impact on the financials, operations, or other activities of the Company on account of the aforesaid order.
